bugs.error_message: FM2 plume_native press-start logo and A-button render black (bg now textured/correct)
bugs.root_cause: NOT XenosRecomp and NOT texture-binding -- both ruled out. (A) NOT translation: B60DDF84 (the shader we 'fixed' for the logo) is NEVER bound at any real draw (0/3830 FM2_LIVE_PS; only CreateShader + PROBE). Its fork translation is byte-identical to clean upstream hedge-dev XenosRecomp (diff exit 0). (B) NOT binding: the logo is actually drawn by 9E93B374 (guest PS obj 0x4005D1B0) -- the SAME 8-stage material shader that already renders the textured background -- and its real art is correctly bound: the logo-banner art at guest base 0x10540000 (877x188, cls=VARIED real content, bc=1, fetch-constant-translated NOT aperture) sits in sampler slot 0 for those draws (FM2_LIVE_PS n=9/12/15 ps=0x4005D1B0 + FM2_LIVE_TEX slot=0 base=0x10540000 tex=..44230 bc=1). So shader+texture are both correct. 9E93B374 is FM2's shared material shader drawing bg+logo+A-button, each its own draw with its own texture and PER-DRAW constants; the bg draws show textured while the logo draw is black WITH THE SAME SHADER AND CORRECT ART => the blackness is per-draw STATE: the 8-stage blend leans on PS float constants (g_ColorTextureStages / c254 / c255 / g_Material) and g_Booleans stage gating. Aperture red herring: the fmt=24 1280x720 uniform-black surfaces (0x0A018000 etc.) sampled by A4AF88D4/composite passes ARE genuinely-empty resolve RTs (guest memory itself is uniform 000000FF, so translating the fetch gives black too) -- that is the separate scene/resolve-RT-black problem, not this logo.
bugs.fix: DIAGNOSED via two runtime instrumentation passes (FM2_MATCONST in d3d_hooks ApplyLivePixelShaderFromContext; FM2_PSUPLOAD at the render_state.cpp constant-upload site). AUTHORITATIVE RESULT for the logo draw (tex0 ptr correlated to FM2_LIVE_TEX base=0x10540000): post-PM4-merge g_ColorTextureStages(0)=PS[6]=[1.000,1.000,0.000,0.000] (texture weight .x=1 => TEXTURE ENABLED), merged=0 (PM4 overlay did NOT drop/replace it), colorWrite=0xF (all channels on), RT=0x130C41000 1280x720 (valid), blend=alpha-over (src=5 SRC_ALPHA, dst=6 INV_SRC_ALPHA). EVERY measurable pipeline input is correct => RULES OUT six subsystems: XenosRecomp translation, texture binding, color constants, colorWrite, render target, blend state. NOTE on the earlier 'constants zero' scare: the first FM2_MATCONST read the game register file at ctx+0x1710 but the shader's PS constants upload from ctx+0x1700 (psConstSrc, register N at byte N*16) -- a one-register shift; corrected, constants are FINE. REMAINING SUSPECTS (narrowed): vertex/geometry stage (collapsed positions, UVs sampling an empty texel, or vertex color iColor0=black), the shader's computed output ALPHA (alpha-over hides a src.a=0 result), or draw-order/coverage (an opaque 9E93B374 draw over the same RT).
